## Changes

### Fixes
- Linux: sources load again. The AppImage was missing the JavaScript engine library, so every source failed with "Failed to load dynamic library 'libquickjs_c_bridge_plugin.so'".
- Linux: opening BacaKomik from the app menu while it is running brings up the open window instead of starting a second one.
- Linux: the dock shows the BacaKomik icon instead of a generic one.
